    "2026-07-26/unknown_polystyrene.csv"
]

    # We assume columns are Raman shift and Intensity based on typical format
    cols = f['columns']
    table = f['table']
    
    # Identify x and y axes (assume first numeric is X, second is Y)
    numeric_cols = [c for c in cols if isinstance(table[c], np.ndarray)]
